parameters.name: ArtifactType
parameters.description:
The type of the artifact. The default value is AcrImage. Valid values:

- HelmChart: a Helm chart image.

- AcrImage: a container image.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page for a paged query. The maximum value is 100. The default value is 20.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token that is used to start the next query.

parameters.name: RepoName
parameters.description: The name of the image repository.
